# 0034: Governed interoperability with the open agent ecosystem

Status: accepted
Type: strategy
Date: 2026-10-23

Request: "please do an assessment and consider making it a project goal and vision to do all that we are trying to accomplish and to try to adopt it towards the agentic ai foundations projects. look at all those projects and plan and spec durably the decisions you make inspired by that. there are 3-4 new projects announced in that today"

## Context

AAIF announced four additions on 2026-10-22; all ten hosted projects are assessed in
the [source review](../../assessments/2026-10-23-aaif-alignment.md). Our G9-G14 outcomes
need portable integration without surrendering their evidence and authority laws.
0024 shares identity, not authority; 0025 sequences admitted compositions; 0026 rejects
model-only authority. I1, I18 and I20 preserve the stdlib core, optional harness and
plan-only coordination. 0003 already tracks the newer MCP revision; its upgrade
trigger is not established by this announcement. Two implementation slots remain bounded.

## Decision

- Add cross-cutting goal G15 and the [alignment specification](../../designs/aaif-alignment.md).
  Become a useful governed-workflow companion to the open ecosystem, not a competing
  protocol, gateway, training engine or mandatory agent platform.
- Qualify Agent Skills/AGENTS.md artifacts and host behavior; qualify the existing
  `UseResponses` lane against a dated Open Responses profile. A supported wire shape
  is not proof of provider parity, calibration, installed hooks or authorization.
- Maintain pinned MCP under 0003. Use MCP as the smallest goose integration candidate;
  a native host adapter needs separate demand and controlled-path evidence.
- Design OpenEnv as an optional evaluation source and OpenSandbox as optional external
  execution infrastructure. Keep independent verdicts, effects and policy in their
  existing owners. Never relabel bounded-exec as isolation or infer safe egress from
  a sandbox product name.
- Keep A2A, agentgateway and Agent Router consumer-driven and conditional. Preserve
  F7/F8/F10; F21 records the conditional external profiles. No new router, worker
  executor, runtime service or transport is admitted.
- Maintain exact compatibility/loss evidence and prepare small upstream reproducer or
  documentation packets when a shared gap is real. Check existing issues and licenses;
  no contribution quota, upstream acceptance claim or automatic public submission.
- This delivery is assessment, vision, decisions and executable acceptance design.
  The [work order](../../plans/aaif-alignment.md) queues implementation under existing
  admission rules; no new slot, dependency, consumer/global mutation or provider spend.

## Rejected alternatives

- Adopt all ten as mandatory dependencies: unnecessary operational coupling. Wins if:
  never as a kit prerequisite; a consumer may select an evidenced optional topology.
- Replace domain ports with one upstream wire format: loses domain laws and native
  strengths. Wins if: a separately reviewed migration preserves those laws and earns
  its cost; protocol popularity alone is insufficient.
- Claim broad AAIF compliance or sandbox/security certification from metadata, unit
  tests or membership: the evidence cannot establish it. Wins if: an exact scoped
  conformance claim has independently reproducible required runtime evidence.
- Build an RL trainer, gateway or sandbox runtime here: duplicates upstream systems.
  Wins if: a named requirement cannot be met by an existing external system and a
  separately admitted design establishes maintenance value without violating I1.
- Submit the kit itself for AAIF hosting now: public-readiness D4 is unratified.
  Wins if: the owner ratifies that boundary and a reviewed proposal demonstrates fit;
  interoperating with existing projects does not require foundation membership.

## Revisit when

Review by 2026-11-21 or next release; a named consumer needs a deferred boundary;
an upstream protocol/license breaks a profile; a supported flow loses evidence,
native capability or authority; setup exceeds 15 minutes; or two consumers reveal
the same missing contract. 0003's protocol clock and existing wave triggers remain
independent. No record is superseded and no compatibility tier changes.
